import { CardGrid, LinkCard } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

The [nest-api](../nest-api/) and [node-worker](../node-worker/) stacks as one
Yarn 4 + Turborepo workspace. The two apps share one Prisma package
(`packages/db`) instead of the worker keeping a copy of the API's schema, so a
schema change and every piece of code it affects land in one commit, and one
build.

```sh
stack new nest-monorepo ./backend --name shop
```

**Stack:** everything in nest-api and node-worker, plus Turborepo 2 over Yarn 4
workspaces. Docker images are built from the monorepo root with
`turbo prune`.

## At a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| Workspaces | `apps/api` (`@scope/api`), `apps/worker` (`@scope/worker`), `packages/db` (`@scope/db`) |
| Database access | `import { PrismaClient } from '@scope/db/client'` in both apps |
| Migrations | owned by the API: `yarn db:migrate` from the root or `apps/api` |
| Dev | `yarn dev` builds `@scope/db`, then runs the API (port 5000) and the worker |
| Local services | one `compose.yml` at the root, shared by both apps |
| Images | `apps/api/Dockerfile` (with a `migrate` target), `apps/worker/Dockerfile` |
| Tests | the API's Vitest unit and e2e suites; `turbo run lint typecheck test build` |

## A monorepo or two repositories?

**Use nest-monorepo** when the worker reads and writes the API's tables, which
is the usual case. Generated as two repositories, the worker needs the API's
schema copied in (or a git submodule) after every migration, and the two drift
silently: the worker compiles against columns that no longer exist until
something fails at runtime.

**Use nest-api and node-worker separately** when the two genuinely release on
their own, different teams own them, or the worker belongs to a different
product.

The worker is the `app-worker` feature, on by default. `--without app-worker`
gives an API-only monorepo that can take the worker later with
`stack add app-worker`.

The app code is the same files as the two source templates: nest-monorepo is
**derived** from them by `templates/nest-monorepo/derive.sh`, which moves the
schema into `packages/db` and rewrites the imports and scripts that change.
